content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have revealed quite a bit of information about several upcoming Apple home products. These include a new HomePod mini, a security camera, a next-generation Siri Remote for the new Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad product.

After digging deeper into the code, it seems to offer important clues about the design of the HomePad...

Filipe Espósito of Engadget found signs suggesting that while the HomePad will most likely run some version of tvOS, it may operate more like a giant Apple Watch.

The code also points to a rather practical privacy feature: when it doesn't detect your iPhone nearby, it won't display your personal information on widgets.

I expect the HomePad to come in two versions — one with a speaker base similar to the HomePod, and another designed for wall mounting.

In addition to the other Apple Home products I mentioned above, several unknown new devices were also mentioned. Personally, I'm really hoping one of them is a smart doorbell. Are there any existing Apple Home products you're particularly excited about? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
